ivy (product): quick sync: customer ACME wants an MVP for eval-triggered alerts + batch/cache recommendations. can we scope a 3-week pilot?

mike (eng): propose minimal MVP: golden-set upload, 2m sampled checks, console alert + webhook, advisor card with batch + ttl recs. auto-fallback out of scope.

jena (solutions): ACME wants per-prompt visibility and a starter template (chat + single-turn).

carlos (cust-success): timeline ask: pilot in 3 weeks. they need a demo with their 25 prompts.

mike (eng): technically ok. risks: noisy alerts and eval cost. mitigation: confirmation run and per-customer eval quotas (default 10m/hr).

ivy (product): acceptance criteria: console alert + webhook, top-10 failing prompts, advisor card, starter templates, runbook. week plan: W1 sampler + UI, W2 alerts + recs, W3 docs + canary.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: optimize-toolkit/sampler -> staging (PR #4310)

jena (solutions): I'll draft templates. carlos will confirm ACME slot. mike to create eng tickets.

ivy (product): add legal check: storing customer prompts for eval. otherwise good to proceed.

carlos (cust-success): ACME OK with constraints, will confirm week 3 window.

ivy (product): great, closing unless blockers.
